title: Product search with filters and pagination
acceptance_criteria:
User Story: Search the product catalogue

Acceptance Criteria:
- Search matches product names containing the search term, ignoring case
- Results can be filtered by category and by price range
- Results show 20 items per page with next/previous controls
- Searching with no matches shows "No products found"
- Search terms longer than 100 characters are rejected with a validation message
- Leading and trailing spaces in the search term are ignored

expected_scenarios.description: Search term returns products whose names contain it, case-insensitive
Price range filter narrows results correctly, including the boundary prices
Exactly 20 results shows one page; 21 results shows a second page
Previous control is unavailable on page 1 and next is unavailable on the last page
Search term of exactly 100 characters is accepted (boundary)
Search term of 101 characters is rejected with a validation message
Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed; whitespace-only search is handled
Special characters / injection payloads in the search term are handled safely
Invalid price range (min greater than max) is handled
